exemptions.why_manifest_bound_state_transition_is_n: The S1 benchmark acceptance (exact_external_intr_ingress_allow, exact_external_intr_egress_allow) defines the InTr ingress disposition and egress decision as inputs supplied to the provider call, so build_s1_provider_call takes them from its caller. Rebinding them to this organization's own InTr ingress/egress transitions read back from its ledger changes the benchmark's acceptance predicates, which is the benchmark owner's decision (StegVerse-Labs/.github#3107, review query Q2).
exemptions.required_evidence_or_repair: Benchmark-owner decision on StegVerse-Labs/.github#3107 Q2; then rebind the provider path's ingress disposition and egress decision to organization-ledger read-back, as StegVerse-org/LLM-adapter#406 did for governed publication, with negative tests for caller-supplied decisions.
exemptions.next_attempt: repair once #3107 Q2 is decided, and remove this exemption in the same change
